title: Quran Study from Roxana 44: Sura 64, Sura 59, and Sura 70 (Composite Recording)
date_note: No date is established. The recording joins three major study blocks.
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/44 - Quran Study From Roxana 344 Sura 64 By Rashad Nothing Happens Angels Are Best Surgons Sura 59 By.csv
document_summary: The first block studies Sura 64 through universal glorification, kingship, perfected design, resurrection, the Day of Mutual Blaming, and claims that illness or disability results from leaving divine protection. Angels are called the best surgeons and are said to guarantee health. Dana then studies Sura 59 on exile, spoils, community generosity, hatred, hypocrisy, Iran, drugs, invisible protection, and Lori's accident. Edip begins Sura 70 with the end-time question, fifty-thousand-year travel, angelic speed, relativity, and seeing the past.

sections.title: Sura 64:1–2, universal glorification, kingship, provision, and Mutual Blaming
sections.summary: Everything, including the bodies of rejecters and every atom, follows God's laws. God determines provision and employment. Humanity divides into believers and disbelievers, and Judgment is called the Day of Mutual Blaming.
related_questions: How did atoms and bodies glorify God?
What is the Day of Mutual Blaming?

sections.title: Perfected design, disability, Rabbi Kushner, angels as surgeons, and health guarantees
